No street crosses Reading at the expected point (5238, 5839): only McGechin subdivision lots on both sides. The nearest candidate is June Street, which runs east from Reading's east side (y ~5590-5665), about 230 px NE of the expected point. It is the likely predecessor of Taft Road (it continues east toward May), but today's alignment at Reading appears to be a later cut. Minnesota Street meets Reading further south at about (5020, 6170).
